name: Simple Content Protector
author: Raju Ahmed

sections.description:
🛡️ Comprehensive Content Protection Plugin for WordPress – Protect Your Content from Copying and Unauthorized Access

Simple Content Protector is a powerful and easy-to-use WordPress plugin that helps protect your website content from being copied, stolen, or inspected. With advanced features and flexible settings, you can customize protection levels according to your needs.

Perfect for:
* Content creators who want to protect their work
* Businesses protecting proprietary information
* Bloggers wanting to prevent content theft
* Online course creators
* Digital product sellers
* Any WordPress site owner who values content security

Key Features:

Core Protection Features:

  • ✅ Disables Mouse Right Click
  • ✅ Disables CTRL+C (Copy)
  • ✅ Disables CTRL+X (Cut)
  • ✅ Disables CTRL+V (Paste)
  • ✅ Disables CTRL+U (View Source)
  • ✅ Disables CTRL+A (Select All)
  • ✅ Disables CTRL+S (Save Page)
  • ✅ Disables CTRL+P (Print)
  • ✅ Disables Image Dragging
  • ✅ Disables Text Selection
  • ✅ Disables F12 Developer Tools
  • ✅ Disables Screenshot/Camera Capture (with 12-layer protection)
  • ✅ Disables Print Screen
  • ✅ Auto-hides content when screenshot tools detected
  • ✅ 200ms opacity changes to break screenshot tools

Advanced Features:

  • ✅ Role-Based Protection – Apply protection to specific user roles
  • ✅ Per-Post Protection Control – Enable/disable protection on individual pages/posts
  • ✅ Exclude Specific Pages – Whitelist pages where protection should be disabled
  • ✅ Logged-in User Control – Disable protection for logged-in users
  • ✅ Selective Feature Toggle – Choose which protection features to enable
  • ✅ Image Protection – Comprehensive image protection against dragging and copying
  • ✅ Print Protection – Prevent users from printing your content
  • ✅ Developer Tools Protection – Disable access to browser developer tools
  • ✅ Watermark Website – Add watermark to website content
  • ✅ Meta Box for Per-Post Settings – Easy control from post editor

How It Works:

The plugin uses a combination of JavaScript and CSS to prevent common content theft methods. It disables:
– Right-click context menus
– Keyboard shortcuts for copy, paste, print, etc.
– Text selection
– Image dragging
– Developer tools access
– Print functionality
– And much more…

Compatibility:

  • WordPress 5.2 or higher
  • PHP 7.2 or higher
  • Works with all themes
  • Compatible with major browsers
  • No conflict with other plugins
  • Lightweight and fast

Security Features:

  • Securely protects your content from copy-paste
  • Prevents source code inspection
  • Blocks screen capture attempts
  • Disables image downloading
  • Protects against content scraping
  • Detects developer tools usage

User-Friendly:

  • Simple one-click activation
  • Easy-to-use admin interface
  • No technical knowledge required
  • Clear settings descriptions
  • Visual feedback for all actions

Support

  • Plugin URL: https://wordpress.org/plugins/simple-wp-content-protector
  • Author: rajubdpro
  • Website: http://codepopular.com
  • Support: Visit the plugin support forum for help

Credits

Developed by rajubdpro for CodePopular.

Privacy

This plugin does not collect, store, or transmit any personal data. All settings are stored locally in your WordPress database.
sections.installation:
📌 Quick Installation Guide

  1. Upload the Plugin

    • Download the simple-wp-content-protector folder
    • Upload it to /wp-content/plugins/ directory via FTP
    • OR install via WordPress admin: Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin

  2. Activate the Plugin

    • Go to WordPress Admin → Plugins
    • Find “Simple Content Protector”
    • Click “Activate”

  3. Configure Settings

    • Navigate to Content Protector in the admin menu
    • Adjust protection settings as needed
    • Click “Save Changes”

✅ You’re Done! Your content is now protected.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin affect website performance?

No, the plugin is lightweight and optimized for performance. It only loads on the frontend when needed.

Can I disable protection for specific pages?

Yes! You can exclude pages by entering their IDs in the settings, or use the per-post meta box to disable protection on individual posts.

Will this work for logged-in users?

You can configure this in the settings. By default, protection is disabled for logged-in users to improve their browsing experience.

Does this protect images?

Yes! The plugin includes comprehensive image protection that prevents dragging, right-clicking, and downloading images.

Can users still copy content with screen capture software?

IMPORTANT: JavaScript-based protection cannot fully prevent OS-level or browser extension screenshot tools. These tools operate outside the browser’s JavaScript environment and can capture screens directly from the operating system.

However, this plugin provides multiple layers of protection:
– Blocks Print Screen keyboard shortcut
– Detects screenshot tool usage patterns
– Hides content when suspicious activity is detected
– Blocks canvas/image data extraction
– Prevents print dialog
– Shows alerts when protection is triggered

While not 100% bulletproof against all third-party screenshot tools, it makes capturing content significantly more difficult and frustrating.

Does this work with page builders?

Yes! The plugin is compatible with all major page builders including Elementor, Beaver Builder, Gutenberg blocks, and more.

Will this interfere with my theme?

The plugin is designed to work seamlessly with all WordPress themes without causing conflicts.
